title: Triad SDK: synchronize credential smoother, backoff profiles, and stream facade; version bumps
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Per-SDK credential "smoother" primitives, harmonized backoff presets, cancelable/peekable stream facade and cross-SDK ergonomic tweaks. Python 1.10.0, TypeScript 2.4.0, Go v1.6.2.
description: Context: Multiple teams reported subtle drift between SDKs when handling credential handoffs and transient auth failures during streaming bursts. This caused uneven retry behavior in high-concurrency scenarios and a small class of leaks where stream consumers could lose termination signals during backoff. Motivation: unify a smaller, well-documented credential "smoother" concept across the three SDKs, standardize retry/backoff presets for streaming, and make the streaming consumer ergonomics safer and easier to reason about across language boundaries. Summary of changes: - Add a lightweight credential_smoother (or CredentialSmoother / CredentialSmootherFactory) in Python/TS/Go that centralizes backoff timing, early-refresh hints, and jitter policy for short-lived delegated tokens. - Introduce a shared 'stream facade' concept: cancelable stream handles, a peek() helper for lookahead, and an explicit close_with_reason API so consumers can detect server-initiated shutdowns reliably. - Harmonize retry/backoff presets: streaming.short_burst, streaming.long_tail, auth.lease_refresh. These presets are encoded as baseline JSON in the repo and consumed by SDKs at build time. - Ergonomics: make stream iterators idempotent re-entry safe (second iteration returns exhausted) and add synchronous close hooks for synchronous SDKs. - Version bumps: Python -> 1.10.0, TypeScript -> 2.4.0, Go -> v1.6.2. Compatibility notes & migration: - Backwards compatible: most users will not need changes. - For custom credential providers that rely on previous refresh timing, a new opt-in argument 'smoother_profile' is available; documented behavior differs slightly (additional 10-15% early-refresh margin). - Stream consumers that relied on implicit cancellation via GC should call close_with_reason to get deterministic shutdown telemetry. Testing & verification: - Added cross-sdk unit suites that run canonical scenarios (short bursts, lease expiry during send, mid-stream credential swap). - End-to-end matrix executed on Linux and macOS runners and on a small GPU-backed integration environment with a mocked token service. - CI had a flaky integration test which was retried and fixed (details below). Checklist: - [x] Implement core smoother & expose opt-in profile - [x] Implement stream facade across SDKs - [x] Add cross-sdk test harness and baseline fixtures - [x] Update docs and changelogs - [x] Version bumps and package publishing scripts updated - [x] Security review for credential surface (approved)
commits: feat(sdk): add credential_smoother core and profiles across py/ts/go
refactor(streams): introduce cancelable/peekable stream facade and close_with_reason
test: add cross-sdk harness and streaming auth scenarios
docs: document smoother API, presets, and migration notes
chore(release): bump versions to py 1.10.0 / ts 2.4.0 / go v1.6.2
review_comments: Arjun: Can you clarify the early-refresh heuristic? Looks like the Python implementation uses 0.12 * ttl while TS uses 0.15 * ttl — please harmonize or make it configurable.
Author (Elena): Good catch. I standardized to 0.13 * ttl and added a 'smoother_profile' config to let users override jitter/early_refresh. Updated implementations in all three SDKs.
Sofia: Tests look comprehensive. One integration flake on macOS runner — seems unrelated but please add a retry wrapper to that specific test.
Author: Added retry decorator and increased the mocked token server's sync window, re-ran CI.
Liam: Small nit: close_with_reason string should be enumerated for telemetry. Recommend adding a typed enum in TS and Go constants in other SDKs.
Author: Added CloseReason enum/const and mapped it in Python/TS/Go. Thanks!
ci_log_summary: CI: cross-sdk integration (triad_matrix.yml) — initial run: 1 flaky test (retried) -> pass
merge_outcome: Merged via squash-and-merge on 2026-03-03. Squash commit message: 'triad(sdk): harmonize credential smoother and stream facade; bump versions'. No conflicts. Post-merge actions: triggered package build pipeline and staged releases for each SDK.
migration_quickstart: Python: replace custom refresh hooks with CredentialSmootherFactory or pass smoother_profile. TypeScript: import { CredentialSmoother, CloseReason } from '@redwood/sdk' and use streamFacade.peek() for prefetch semantics. Go: use credential.NewSmootherFromProfile() and call Handle.CloseWithReason(backend.CloseReasonLeaseExpired). See docs/sdk-migration/credential-smoother.md for examples.
notes_on_backward_compatibility: Default presets preserve prior behavior for typical call patterns. Only callers that used aggressive custom refresh windows may notice earlier refresh. All changes are opt-in via smoother_profile or default presets; no mandatory code changes required for existing consumers.
security_review: Security review completed on 2026-02-28. Minor findings: ensure token caching TTL respects KMS rotation windows — addressed by adding an explicit max_refresh_lead config. Approved.
publisher_tasks: CI job 'publish-sdk' queued post-merge and executed. Python wheel pushed to internal index and staged to PyPI candidate; TS package published under canary tag then promoted; Go module tag v1.6.2 pushed.
